purpose: Teach: 有能/異例/セクター/ワイド/賞金/物品/非常勤/マネジャー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、有能な研究者を目指せ
lines.en: Ren, aim to become a capable researcher.
lines.style: Measured, direct address. Opening emphasis on the name. Steady tempo, no rush. Underlying warmth beneath the formal instruction—this is an investment in him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教官は学会で異例のご発表をされました
lines.en: Yes. My advisor actually gave an unprecedented presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Respectful but eager to show he's listening, learning. Quick pickup on the opening word. Slight lift of pride when mentioning the advisor's work—genuine admiration, not flattery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、教育セクターでの研究にも興味を持て
lines.en: Ren, develop an interest in education sector research too.
lines.style: Clear directive, similar weight to the first line. Direct eye contact level. Slower on 'education'—letting it land. Not a suggestion; a steering hand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。ワイドな視点で論文を書きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll approach my papers from a broader perspective.
lines.style: Quiet assent, immediate. No hesitation. Slight formality in the phrasing—he's taking notes mentally. Steady, compliant, but not robotic. A young man trying to meet expectations.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、コンペで賞金を狙え
lines.en: Ren, aim for the prize money in the competition.
lines.style: Third directive, delivered with the same composure. Slight edge of challenge underneath—not harsh, but unapologetic. He's being pushed, and Hiroshi knows he can take it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究用物品の管理を徹底しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm making sure to manage research materials carefully.
lines.style: Quick response, moving slightly faster. Shows he's already thinking ahead, already executing. Formal tone but genuine—not reciting, reporting. Small satisfaction underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、非常勤の助手にも丁寧に接しろ
lines.en: Ren, treat the part-time assistants with care and respect.
lines.style: Subtle shift here—gentler than the previous directives. Same formal delivery, but the pause before 'care' is longer. This is about character. Hiroshi sees something worth correcting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室マネジャーから多くを学んでおります
lines.en: Yes. I'm learning a lot from our lab manager.
lines.style: Final line carries weight. Softer opening than previous responses. Almost reflective—he understands the lesson just embedded in that last directive. Slight trailing-off, a moment of quiet recognition.
